profile.headline: Software Engineer | MS CS @ USC
profile.summary:
As a passionate and results-driven software developer, I bring over two years of professional experience complemented by a Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Southern California. My journey in software development has been fueled by a deep curiosity for solving complex problems and leveraging technology to drive impactful solutions.

I specialize in 𝐬𝐨𝐟𝐭𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭, 𝐦𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐚𝐮𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠, and 𝐜𝐲𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐲, equipping me with a versatile toolkit to tackle challenges across diverse domains. Known for my ability to dive into perplexing challenges, I thrive on finding creative and effective solutions. Whether it's building intelligent systems, crafting innovative games, or securing digital assets, I am committed to delivering excellence in every project I undertake.

I’m exploring opportunities to collaborate with forward-thinking organizations where I can contribute my expertise and grow as a professional. If you’re looking for a 𝐝𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐦-𝐬𝐨𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐫 with a passion for innovation, let’s connect! I’d love to discuss how my skills and experiences align with your goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · PostgreSQL · Express.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js

positions.title: Research Development Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Worked on a medical VR team developing surgical simulation tools in Unity, including interactive systems for drilling, slicing, and chevron cutting to replicate bunion surgery procedures in VR.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity · Virtual Reality (VR) · Research and Development (R&D)

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Designed and delivered lectures on game design and analytics for 80+ students, structuring curriculum and guiding Unity-based game projects for master’s level course (CSCI 526) under Professor Scott Easley.
positions.insights: Skills: Assistant Teaching · Unity · Game Design · Game Development · Leadership · Team Management

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked at USAA Bank as a consultant through Tata Consultancy Services.
Refactored a Golang based loan payment project, boosting efficiency and implementing industry best practices.
Modernized services by analyzing and developing APIs in Java and Spring Boot, integrating downstream services and updating API infrastructure to align with evolving business requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Java · Spring Boot

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a solution for effective client relationship management. 
Assuring the resiliency of information and cybersecurity applications, as well as ensuring compliance with company security standards.
Building automation test suites to enhance system and integration testing techniques and testing efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Test Automation · JavaScript · Java · PostgreSQL · Spring Framework

positions.title: Research And Development Intern
positions.description: Implemented an end-to-end product that detects employees wearing masks in the workplace in real-time using security cameras.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Software Development · Machine Learning

positions.title: Sub-Head of Web Development
positions.description: Built a reusable framework which allows a yearbook to be published digitally as a cross-platform application with a server-driven UI.

positions.title: Research And Development Intern
positions.description:
Tested external data security APIs and developed services responsible for securing data at rest.
Created middleware to perform tokenization/detokenization operations on sensitive data.

positions.title: System Administrator and Web Developer
positions.description: Developed over 20 internal and external websites for the intercollegiate fests hosted by MIT Manipal which ensured secure payments and a smooth registration process while collecting analytics.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Researched graduate student incomes in the process of developing the income prediction model.
